facts.text: Raffles Jakarta was founded by Dr (HC) Ir. Ciputra, an avid collector of Hendra Gunawan paintings.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Jakarta was founded by Dr (HC) Ir. Ciputra, an avid collector of Hendra Gunawan paintings.

facts.text: Ciputra opened Raffles Jakarta in March 2015 as a place where Hendra Gunawan's legacy comes to life.
facts.excerpt: in March 2015 he opened Raffles Jakarta as a place where Gunawan's legacy comes to life.

facts.text: The hotel has installations articulating subjects from Gunawan's paintings, especially rural life and nature.
facts.excerpt: There are also installations articulating subjects from Gunawan’s paintings, especially the charm of rural life and the beauty of nature.

facts.text: The hotel is in the Kuningan district of Jakarta's golden triangle and is linked to Lotte Shopping Avenue and the Ciputra Artpreneur Centre.
facts.excerpt: Rising above the burgeoning commercial hub in the Kuningan district of Jakarta’s golden triangle, the hotel is linked to Lotte Shopping Avenue and the Ciputra Artpreneur Centre

facts.text: The Ciputra Artpreneur Centre is home to The Hendra Gunawan Museum, a gallery and a Broadway Musical Theatre.
facts.excerpt: the Ciputra Artpreneur Centre, home to The Hendra Gunawan Museum, a gallery and a 1,200-seat Broadway Musical Theatre

facts.text: Soekarno-Hatta International Airport is about 28 km away.
facts.excerpt: Jakarta Convention Centre is 3 km away, and Soekarno-Hatta International Airport about 28km.

facts.text: Rooms are infused with the creative influence of local artist Hendra Gunawan.
facts.excerpt: rooms are infused with the dazzling creative influence of the renowned local artist, Hendra Gunawan.

facts.text: Bathrobes are designed by IKAT Indonesia by Didiet Maulana, inspired by Hendra Gunawan artworks and local batik patterns.
facts.excerpt: Our bathrobes are designed by IKAT Indonesia by Didiet Maulana with design inspirations from Hendra Gunawan artworks as well as local batik patterns.

facts.text: The Raffles Club is on the 12th floor with views of the Jakarta skyline.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 12th floor of the Raffles, with spectacular views of the Jakarta skyline, the Raffles Club is an exclusive sanctuary in the heart of the city.

facts.text: Raffles Jakarta butlers are trained by Heilbron Hospitality and Aspire Globally.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Jakarta butlers are trained by Heilbron Hospitality and Aspire Globally

facts.text: A Raffles Royal Host is a historian with knowledge of the hotel and its art collection.
facts.excerpt: a Raffles Royal Host is a historian with encyclopaedic knowledge of the hotel and its art collection.

facts.text: Arts Cafe serves Continental and Asian a la carte dishes with a backdrop of Hendra Gunawan's artwork.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Continental and Asian à la carte offerings, served in chic surroundings with a backdrop of Hendra Gunawan's vibrant artwork.

facts.text: Arts Cafe has a Japanese corner and desserts from Raffles Patisserie.
facts.excerpt: specialities from our Japanese corner, alongside delightful desserts from Raffles Pâtisserie.

facts.text: The Butcher's Table at Arts Cafe is a Friday night chef's table with a menu of premium meats and wines.
facts.excerpt: Come to Arts Cafe for a chef’s table with a difference: A Friday night soirée featuring a creative menu of premium meats and selection of wines

facts.text: The Butcher's Table is available only by reservation.
facts.excerpt: Our Butcher’s Table is a chef’s table with a difference, a special treat available only by reservation.

facts.text: Navina Pool Bar offers cabana dining in the Hendra Gunawan Garden on the 14th floor.
facts.excerpt: Discover a serene cabana dining experience at Navina Pool Bar, located in the Hendra Gunawan Garden on the 14th floor.

facts.text: The Writers Bar hosts evenings of live jazz piano with signature rum cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Unwind to the smooth rhythms of live jazz piano, accompanied by signature rum cocktails and thoughtfully curated light bites.

facts.text: Raffles Spa has six treatment suites, an outdoor whirlpool and steam rooms, plus an outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Rediscover your centre in one of our six beautiful treatment suites; or head for the outdoor pool

facts.text: The spa uses Kerstin Florian products for facials and Tropical Spa for body care.
facts.excerpt: The spa uses premium products of Kerstin Florian for facials and Tropical Spa for body care

facts.text: The Signature Heritage Massage incorporates Lomi Lomi, Balinese and Javanese techniques.
facts.excerpt: Experience Indonesian heritage through a head-to-toe massage incorporating Lomi Lomi, Balinese and Javanese techniques.

facts.text: The fitness facilities use Technogym equipment.
facts.excerpt: world-class fitness facilities with Technogym® equipment

facts.text: The hotel has eight meeting spaces.
facts.excerpt: Eight versatile and sophisticated meeting spaces, designed to inspire productivity and host impactful events.

facts.text: The best time to visit Jakarta is the dry season, from May to September.
facts.excerpt: The best time to visit Jakarta is during the dry season, from May to September, when the weather is more pleasant for exploring the city.

facts.text: Arts Cafe has two private dining rooms.
facts.excerpt: Within the restaurant, two beautifully decorated private rooms offer an inspiring dining experience.

facts.text: Rooms are some of the most sought-after in the city.
facts.excerpt: rooms at Raffles Jakarta are some of the most sought-after in the city.
